issues.quote: The regulator on the wall had stopped.
issues.fact: The fact sheet gives no information about the regulator, or any stopped time on it.
issues.misreading: A solver could treat the stopped regulator as a clock reading or time of death, and try to fit it against the kitchen-clock times in R1 to R3.

issues.quote: His little watch, the one that strikes when you press the slide, was in his hand.
issues.fact: The fact sheet says nothing about a striking watch or its use.
issues.misreading: The striking mechanism suggests a sound-based timing clue, which could lead a solver to infer when the watch was struck or pressed, a whereabouts or duration the sheet does not give.
